name: hooks-attribution-guard
description: Advises against AI authorship attribution in git commits (Co-Authored-By Claude/Anthropic, "Generated with/by AI", "AI-assisted/AI-generated", Claude Code trailers). Emits a non-blocking advisory (allow + additionalContext, exit 0) so the human stays the sole author of record. Scoped to attribution trailers/phrases so prose mentioning AI is not flagged. Cross-tool (Claude + Codex).
